summary: Arcutis Biotherapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity program of up to $200,000,000 of common stock sold through or to TD Cowen as sales agent under an amended and restated sales agreement. Shares may be sold by any lawful method, including on Nasdaq or via negotiated block trades, with TD Cowen compensated up to 3.0% of gross proceeds; no escrow arrangement exists. Last reported sale price was $32.00 on November 3, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and overhang versus daily trading volume.
